final: WITH state_accounts AS (SELECT c.state_county_province, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_base FROM Customers AS c LEFT JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), state_shares AS (SELECT account_base, 1.0 * account_base / SUM(account_base) OVER () AS share FROM state_accounts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM state_shares) SELECT SUM(s.account_base) AS combined_account_base, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.share) AS average_excess_share FROM state_shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.share
